description: This Python source file defines a test case class for self-testing eSDK (Embedded Software Development Kit) related functionalities within a build system. It includes methods for environment setup, SDK generation, configuration updating, and specific tests like installing libraries/headers and generating images. The class centrally manages environment variables, filesystem manipulations, and command executions related to eSDK automation.
